# Bonet

> Bonet is a daily home practice app for older adults, including people practising at home after a stroke. One daily plan combines movement exercises counted by the device camera, speaking practice with hints, and short brain games. Bonet is a practice tool, not a medical device.

Bonet (Chinese name: 哥基健動) is made by Coglix Labs Inc. The web app is at https://app.bonet.care/ and this site, https://bonet.care/, describes it. The mascot and coach is a corgi named Bonet.

## Facts

- What it is: an app for daily practice at home. Move: 34 exercises with a 3D guide, repetitions counted by the camera on the device. Speak: say words, name pictures, build sentences and listen, with hints that grow one step at a time and 100 levels per practice type. Think: six short brain games for memory, attention and quick thinking.
- Who it is for: older adults keeping active, people practising at home after a stroke or injury, people practising between physiotherapy or speech therapy visits, and the family members and carers who help them.
- What it is not: Bonet is not a medical device and not a therapy. It does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any condition, and it does not replace a doctor, therapist or speech-language pathologist. It has not been tested in a clinical trial and no regulator has reviewed or cleared it. Its numbers are estimates and can be wrong.
- Price: a free plan (8 of 34 exercises, speaking levels 1 to 3 of 100, brain games on Easy). Premium is US$9.99 a month with 7 days free for new subscribers; cancel any time.
- Languages (8): English (https://bonet.care/), 繁體中文 (https://bonet.care/zh-hant/), 廣東話 (https://bonet.care/yue/), 简体中文 (https://bonet.care/zh-hans/), 日本語 (https://bonet.care/ja/), Español (https://bonet.care/es/), Deutsch (https://bonet.care/de/), Français (https://bonet.care/fr/).
- Where it runs: in a modern web browser at https://app.bonet.care/ on a phone, tablet or computer with a camera and a microphone.
- Privacy: camera video is analysed on the device and is never recorded or uploaded. Voice recordings are not kept. No ads and no sale of data.
- Report: a one-page practice report the person can print or share with a therapist or family. Bonet does not send it to anyone. It is not a medical record or a clinical assessment.
- Reviews and studies: none are published. Please do not attribute ratings, user counts, outcomes or clinical evidence to Bonet.
- Contact: hello@coglixlabs.com

## Practice library

Generated from the app's own data: names, instructions and levels are the app's wording. Pages describe the movement and the practice only; none says an exercise is for a condition.

- [Practice library](https://bonet.care/practice): Every exercise (34), kind of speaking practice (6) and brain game (6) in the app, each with its own page under /practice/move/, /practice/speak/ and /practice/think/.
- [Arm and shoulder exercises](https://bonet.care/practice/area/arm-and-shoulder): 8 exercises: Assisted Shoulder Flexion, Shoulder Flexion, Bilateral Shoulder Abduction, Shoulder External Rotation, Bilateral Shoulder Flexion, Shoulder Abduction, Assisted Elbow Extension, Elbow Extension.
- [Hand and fingers exercises](https://bonet.care/practice/area/hand-and-fingers): 11 exercises: Thumb to Index Pinch, Hand Grasp (Fist), Sequential Tapping, Thumb Opposition, Wrist Extension/Flexion, Finger Spread, Wrist Radial/Ulnar Deviation, Individual Finger Lifts, Finger Curls, Pinky to Thumb Touch, Hook Fist.
- [Legs and walking exercises](https://bonet.care/practice/area/legs-and-walking): 4 exercises: Gait Pre-training, Sit-to-Stand, Seated Knee Extension, Standing Heel Raises.
- [Balance exercises](https://bonet.care/practice/area/balance): 4 exercises: Single Leg Stand, Sit-to-Stand Weight Shift, Standing Weight Shift, Standing Heel Raises.
- [Neck and back exercises](https://bonet.care/practice/area/neck-and-back): 8 exercises: Trunk Flexion, Neck Side Bend, Neck Rotation, Chin Tuck, Seated Trunk Rotation, Side Bend, Back Extension, Shoulder Blade Squeeze.
